blurb: Guests fish for Striped Bass, Bluefish, Tuna, White Marlin, Sharks, and other big fish in the waters off Martha's Vineyard and the Elizabeth Islands. The charter operates aboard the 35' custom Duffy "Lauren C", a Coastguard licensed vessel. Trips include half-day and full-day options, with opportunities to catch trophy fish and participate in the Martha's Vineyard Striped Bass and Bluefish Derby.
